name: Colleen Ullrich
message: Have an amazing time! Thanks for the KitKats & limoncello 🍋 I will wait to drink it and I'll share it with Jim this time 😘
reply: Colleen — that made us both smile. Eat the KitKats whenever you want. The limoncello can wait for a night with Jim. We'll raise a glass in Crete and think of you two.

name: Таня
message: Whoooooooooaaaaaaaaaa! This is the coolest thing I've ever seen!! Can't wait to follow!!
reply: Таня — that note made our morning. Follow along. We'll keep putting the days up so you can ride along from home.

name: Daniel & Julia
message: Hi — leave us a note. We'll read every one from the road, and write back when we can.
reply: Thank you for being here with us. Save the page and come along.
